title: St. Pete Marathon (Inaugural)
startFinish: Flora Wylie Park, Historic Old Northeast
heroImageAlt: Downtown St. Petersburg, Florida skyline reflected in the bay just before sunrise
heroCredit: Photo: Andrew Heneen, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
pitch: December 2027 is the first running of the St. Pete Marathon, St. Petersburg's inaugural December marathon. It's a fast, flat waterfront course that starts and finishes at Flora Wylie Park in Historic Old Northeast and stays inside the city the whole way.

The race is home to the 2027 USATF Florida Association Marathon Open and Masters Championships. Morrow Media is working with the event to bring on its founding partners, the brands whose names are attached to the race from day one.
